objectives: Decode taught br-words by mapping graphemes and phonemes in order.
Blend the br onset with the vowel and ending to read a complete word.
Distinguish short-vowel words such as brag, brim, brick, and brush.
Reread and self-correct when a consonant or vowel is omitted.
concepts: The letters b and r represent two consonants in the initial br blend.
The vowel and final consonant must also be decoded; the onset alone is not the whole word.
Short vowels differ and must be heard precisely.
A final read-back checks the decoded word.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a sound.
The consonant sound or blend before the vowel in a syllable.
Noticing an error and repairing it by checking the word again.

workedExamples.solution: Both begin br, but brag has short /a/ and brim has short /i/.

commonMistakes: Reading only the br onset and guessing the rest.
Confusing short /i/ in brim with short /a/ in brag.
Dropping the last sound in brick or brush.
Treating the blend as one sound and omitting /r/.
keyTakeaways: Map every sound from left to right.
Read the whole word again to check it.

basic.prompt: Which word has the short /a/ sound?

higherOrderThinking.prompt: Why do you read the whole word after blending?
higherOrderThinking.answer: To check that every sound matches

higherOrderThinking.prompt: Which word begins br and has a short /i/ vowel and final /k/?

mixedReview.prompt: What is wrong with saying buh-rush for brush?
mixedReview.answer: A vowel was added inside the blend

mixedReview.prompt: Which word is not a br-word?
What is the strongest self-correction strategy?
mixedReview.answer: Map the sounds again and reread the whole word

weakTopicRevision: If decoding is weak, revisit the worked examples, say the sound evidence aloud, and retry fresh items before advancing.

activities.name: Tap, map, blend, and reread br words.
steps: Listen to or read each target word carefully.
Say or map each sound in the correct order.
Complete the task and explain the sound or text evidence.
Reread or repeat the word to check accuracy.

activities.name: Find and repair a target-pattern error.
steps: Review a word or sentence with one target-pattern error.
Identify the sound, spelling, or evidence that does not match.
Correct the item and explain the correction.
Try a fresh item without looking at the answer.
